'''Taum Reese''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tive/Legends|Tive]] in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]], located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. Taum Reese had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and, along with [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], was one of the two terrestrial planets in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]], except [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
